segments.name: Financial PR
segments.description: Provides financial public relations services to Hong Kong listed companies, IPO candidates, private companies and investors.
segments.evidence: The Company operates a single line of business, providing financial public relations ("Financial PR") services, and manages its operations as an integrated whole.

revenueModel.text: Clients pay fixed project-based service fees, generally in stages or in full before services are performed, plus periodic fixed retainer fees, with out-of-pocket expenses reimbursed.
revenueModel.evidence: In general, we receive (i) fixed service fees in respect of our provision of Financial PR services, which are payable in stages; and (ii) periodic (monthly, quarterly or semi-annually) fixed services fees in respect of our provision of retainer services to clients.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company acquired a PRC subsidiary (Shenzhen Huiyue Technology Limited) and LQ Capital Limited, but management concluded these did not create separate operating segments.
changes.evidence: During the year ended November 30, 2025, the Company completed the acquisition of a PRC subsidiary. Management evaluated the impact of the acquisition and concluded that it did not result in a separate operating segment, as the CODM continues to review financial information on a consolidated basis and does not separately assess performance or allocate resources to the PRC subsidiary.
